rows.name: DIGIT
rows.manufacturer: Design: Meta AI (FAIR). Manufacturing and sales: GelSight Inc. (Waltham, MA)
rows.principle: Optical / vision-based: camera + elastomer (gel) + RGB LED illumination
rows.measured: Contact geometry (RGB tactile image), texture; normal/shear force and slip only inferred with models (not calibrated in N)
rows.review_status: Imported research compilation; original-source review pending

rows.name: GelSight Mini
rows.year: 2022 (approx. commercial launch; MIT GelSight technology since 2009)
rows.principle: Optical / vision-based: photometric stereo on a Lambertian silicone gel with RGB LEDs
rows.measured: 3D topography / contact geometry and texture (2D and 3D); with marker gel: shear and slip estimation. Force not calibrated
rows.review_status: Imported research compilation; original-source review pending

rows.name: DIGIT 360
rows.manufacturer: Meta FAIR; commercialisation with GelSight Inc.
rows.status: Not on general sale: free units for researchers via Call for Proposals; commercialisation announced with GelSight. Design published (CC BY-NC 4.0)
rows.principle: Multimodal: hemispherical optical (camera + elastomer) + pressure + vibration/audio + temperature + gases (smell) + IMU; on-device AI accelerator (GAP9)
rows.measured: Omnidirectional contact geometry, normal and shear force, vibration up to 10 kHz, heat, smell, acceleration/orientation
rows.review_status: Imported research compilation; original-source review pending

rows.name: uSkin
rows.manufacturer: XELA Robotics Co., Ltd. (Tokyo; Waseda spin-off, founded 2018)
rows.principle: Magnetic / Hall effect (magnets in silicone over Hall chips, digital output)
rows.measured: 3-axis force per taxel (normal Z + shear X/Y); temperature per taxel; torques inferred with ≥3 contacts
rows.review_status: Imported research compilation; original-source review pending

rows.name: PX-6AX GEN4 (PX6AX GEN4)
rows.manufacturer: PaXini Tech (帕西尼感知科技) (not Contactile)
rows.year: 2026 (GEN4 / FUSE chip launch, August 2026); previous generations GEN2/GEN3
rows.status: On sale (official PaXini store and distributors)
rows.principle: 'ITPU' multidimensional tactile sensor with GEN4 FUSE chip. The manufacturer does not detail the physical principle; the 'Magnetic Armour' protection against external fields suggests magnetic transduction (inference, not confirmed)
rows.measured: Distributed 3D force, resultant force and 3D torque (6D); texture, material and temperature (15+ parameters according to the manufacturer)
rows.review_status: Imported research compilation; original-source review pending

rows.name: PapillArray
rows.status: On sale (Development Kit v2.0 on request for quote)
rows.principle: Optical per pillar: LED + pinhole + photodiodes inside silicone pillars
rows.measured: Per pillar: 3D displacement, 3D force and vibration. Global: 3D force, 3D torque, incipient slip, friction
rows.review_status: Imported research compilation; original-source review pending

rows.name: RoboTact
rows.manufacturer: Pressure Profile Systems, Inc. (PPS), Hawthorne, California
rows.year: Exact year Not available (brochure Nov 2025; PPS active in robotics since 1996–2008)
rows.status: On sale as a development kit (on request for quote) and OEM license
rows.measured: Contact onset, force, contact location and area, pressure distribution, vibration, incipient slip (with silicone pad)
rows.review_status: Imported research compilation; original-source review pending

rows.name: FingerVision
rows.manufacturer: FingerVision Inc. (株式会社FingerVision, Tokyo); origin: A. Yamaguchi and C. Atkeson (CMU)
rows.status: On sale as a set (gripper + sensors + control PC), price on enquiry; original research version open source
rows.principle: Optical / vision: transparent silicone skin with markers + camera (also sees through the skin: 'proximity vision')
rows.measured: XYZ force distribution (marker displacement), slip (pixel differences), estimated torque, vision of the nearby object
rows.review_status: Imported research compilation; original-source review pending
rows.licence: Original repo: no SPDX license detected (see repo)

rows.name: BioTac SP
rows.year: Original BioTac 2008; SP version later (exact year Not available)
rows.status: Discontinued: SynTouch dissolved in December 2024; only used/legacy units
rows.principle: Conductive fluid + impedance electrodes; pressure transducer (hydro-acoustic); thermistor + heater
rows.measured: Deformation (normal/shear force, contact point), fluid vibration and pressure, temperature and heat flux; slip, texture, curvature
rows.review_status: Imported research compilation; original-source review pending

rows.name: ReSkin
rows.manufacturer: Meta AI + Carnegie Mellon University (Bhirangi, Hellebrekers, Majidi, Gupta)
rows.status: Open source (MIT); no official sales (commercial derivatives via AnySkin/WowSkin)
rows.principle: Magnetic: elastomer with magnetic microparticles + magnetometers (5× MLX90393)
rows.measured: Contact location and 3-axis force (normal/shear) via learned models; fast signals for slip
rows.review_status: Imported research compilation; original-source review pending

rows.name: AnySkin
rows.manufacturer: New York University (Pinto, Bhirangi) with CMU, Columbia and Meta
rows.status: Open source (MIT); ready-to-use version sold by third parties (WowRobo 'WowSkin')
rows.principle: Magnetic: DragonSkin 10 skin + magnetised MQFP-15-7 particles, separate from the electronics (5 3-axis magnetometers)
rows.measured: Contact, slip (92% accuracy), forces via learned models; generalises across skin instances
rows.review_status: Imported research compilation; original-source review pending

rows.name: TacTip
rows.manufacturer: Bristol Robotics Laboratory (Univ. of Bristol + UWE) — N. Lepora and others
rows.status: Open source / research; commercialisation initiative at tactip.org (contact via BRL)
rows.principle: Biomimetic optical: internal camera tracks pins/markers on a gel-filled 3D-printed skin
rows.measured: Contact shape/edge and position, shear, slip, texture, faint vibrations; force estimated with learning
rows.review_status: Imported research compilation; original-source review pending
rows.licence: Not available (designs published on Soft Robotics Toolkit)

rows.name: GelSlim 4.0
rows.manufacturer: University of Michigan, MMint Lab (Sipos, van den Bogert, Fazeli) (not MIT MCube)
rows.principle: Optical / vision in a slim finger (gel + laser-cut flat lens + LEDs; optional markers)
rows.measured: Contact depth/geometry (learned), shear field, slip, in-hand object pose
rows.review_status: Imported research compilation; original-source review pending

rows.name: 9DTact
rows.manufacturer: Shanghai Qi Zhi Institute + Tsinghua University (Changyi Lin, Huazhe Xu)
rows.principle: Optical / vision: two-layer gel (translucent + black) with white light; darker = deeper (no markers)
rows.measured: 3D shape reconstruction; 6D force (3 forces + 3 torques) estimated with a neural network
rows.review_status: Imported research compilation; original-source review pending

rows.name: OmniTact
rows.manufacturer: UC Berkeley (BAIR) — Padmanabha, Ebert, Tian, Calandra, Finn, Levine
rows.principle: Optical / multi-camera vision: 5 micro-cameras (endoscope) under a gel skin
rows.measured: Multidirectional deformations; contact angle and contact state (inferred with CNN)
rows.review_status: Imported research compilation; original-source review pending

rows.name: Minsight
rows.manufacturer: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems, Stuttgart (Andrussow, Sun, Kuchenbecker, Martius)
rows.principle: Optical / vision: 160° fisheye camera inside an elastic shell over a metal skeleton; photometric stereo + learning
rows.measured: 3D force vector map (normal and shear) over the whole surface; contact location
rows.review_status: Imported research compilation; original-source review pending

rows.name: eFlesh
rows.manufacturer: New York University (Pattabiraman, Huang, Panozzo, Zorin, Pinto, Bhirangi)
rows.principle: Magnetic: 3D-printed (TPU) 'cut-cell' microstructures with neodymium magnets + magnetometer board
rows.measured: Contact location, normal and shear force (learned), slip (95%)
rows.review_status: Imported research compilation; original-source review pending

rows.name: DigiTac
rows.manufacturer: University of Bristol / Bristol Robotics Lab (Lepora et al.)
rows.principle: Hybrid optical: DIGIT electronics/camera + 3D-printed TacTip skin with markers and gel
rows.measured: Like TacTip: contact pose/shape, shear, slip (markers)
rows.review_status: Imported research compilation; original-source review pending

rows.name: F-TAC Hand
rows.manufacturer: Peking University (Institute for AI) + BIGAI (Beijing Institute for General AI); collab. QMUL (Althoefer)
rows.status: Research prototype (complete hand, not a standalone sensor); data and code on Zenodo
rows.principle: Optical / vision: 17 vision sensors (OV2640 with 160° lens) with Lambertian membrane and RGBW LEDs
rows.measured: Contact geometry and deformation over 70% of the palmar surface; used for adaptive grasping
rows.review_status: Imported research compilation; original-source review pending
rows.licence: Open-access article; code license Not available
